physics_notes:
# open_trash_bin

Built from existing undistorted source frames; offline modeling, not online estimation. No new capture.

Open-top black polypropylene bin with removable metallic ring, matching the Umbra Vento product family by proportions and top profile (inferred identification). The top is a separate movable lift-off lid/ring. No lid actuation or rear hinge is visible in f5008/f5016/f5026; alternative swing mechanism remains unverified. Forty-eight wall sectors retain thin contact geometry.

Geometry and placement: size is [X,Y,Z] metres; placement is bottom centre in supplied metric WORLD. Counter supports use layout heights (prep 0.955 m; sink 1.025 m); floor 0. Sources and raw depth samples are in ../measurements.json. Transparent/specular depth outliers are not accepted as dimensions. Shape details, hidden backs, thickness, density, mass, friction, and unactuated joint limits are priors. Approximate placement uncertainty 3–5 cm; depth scale reported about 4%.

Review: source crops retain exact frame IDs. Calibrated static cameras use original intrinsics/poses and world placement. Held/demo views are evidence only; static render cannot explain hand motion. No quantitative silhouette accuracy claimed.

Source label colours retain capture lighting. Material roughness and fine normals are explicit priors; bamboo micrograin was synthesized from the reference crop. Fine labels are photo crops, not newly invented text.

Simulation: Blender has active compound rigid bodies and supported constraints, initially disabled for inspection; enable rigidbody_world for simulation. Lift-off parts have no artificial slide joint. The scene has no floor/support fixture. Use collision map to assemble compound bodies in your simulator; GLB carries visuals and names, while JSON supplies physics/joints. Collision margin 0.4 mm. No friction/mass calibration or dynamic task evaluation performed.

Run Blender 4.2 headlessly with `blender -b -P build.py`. Inputs: config.json and textures/photo_basecolor.jpg. The script regenerates meshes, PBR microtexture and render files. Build/render wall time is recorded in model.json; excludes measurement/modeling time.

physics_properties.mass_basis: Sum of explicit constituent mass_budget components; see dimensions, density and assumptions there.

physics_properties.density_basis: constituent solid prior, NOT envelope density
physics_properties.friction_basis: user-specified material range; sponge and textile are tentative
physics_properties.center_of_mass_basis: Mass-weighted volume centroids of material-budget components; estimated fill/ballast/textile densities.

mass_budget.basis: Analytic thin shell area × physical gauge (body 0.45 mm + 1.3 mm base; rim 0.7 mm; liner 35 µm). Contact hull faceting is excluded from physical mass.

physics_properties.estimated_dry_or_filled: Filled state for soap/syrup/pump/bread/food/tea; dry state for textiles/sponge/scourer.
physics_properties.blender_inertia_limit: Blender fallback mass is synchronized; its pivot/inertia is approximate. MJCF specifies explicit material-budget COM and estimated inertias.

limitations: Open-top black bin with removable stainless ring. The stainless top is a separate movable lift-off lid/ring. No lid actuation or rear hinge is visible in f5008/f5016/f5026; alternative swing mechanism remains unverified. Forty-eight wall sectors retain thin contact geometry.

provenance.geometry: Reconstructed from kitchen video; hidden surfaces are completed. Scale and material appearance remain approximate.
provenance.motion: Observed trajectories where documented; unobserved axes and endpoints are assumptions.
provenance.forces: Simulation measurements of assumed parameters; not force measurements from video.

visual_bindings_note: Visuals use the latest asset revision; mechanism geometry may predate it. Body rest offsets preserve the visual placement.
